name: TsOD Kalininsky (Atomdata / Rosatom), Udomlya
notes: Atomdata flagship commercial colocation data center at Udomlya, Tver Oblast, adjacent to Kalinin NPP; launched Sept 2019 per Rosatom press; design total 33,800 m2 / up to 8,000 rack places across 5 buildings with ~80 MW consumed power (tadviser/atomic-energy; capacity is design-phase figure - first phase operational). Official Atomdata page lists TsOD Kalininsky as active. Per RU methodology this is the nuclear-adjacent power-rich flagship for the Tver division.

name: Rostelecom TsOD Udomlya
notes: Rostelecom (RTK-DC subsidiary) put into commercial operation its TsOD Udomlya data center near the Kalinin NPP in Tver Oblast (July 2019 press, client equipment placement started at commissioning). Regional telecommunication/data-center facility in the nuclear power corridor; capacity not disclosed in sources.

name: TsOD Mendeleev (Rosenergoatom x Rostelecom), Udomlya
notes: Joint investment project of Rosenergoatom and Rostelecom for a large data center at Udomlya (Tver Oblast) near Kalinin NPP, described as one of the largest DCs in Russia/Europe; press-only lead (wik-end), no current permit/EGRZ or operator page verified in this pass - keep planned until official confirmation.

name: Yandex data center (mikrorayon Energetik, Vladimir)
notes: Yandex-owned data center in Vladimir (mikrorayon Energetik), built by general contractor HAKA: 2,880 racks, 14.48 ha site, constructed in ~11 months; Yandex careers/infrastructure pages confirm an active DC location in Vladimir. One of Yandex's largest Russian DCs outside Moscow region.

name: Yandex new data center No.6 (Vladimir Oblast)
notes: Vedomosti (2025-09-24): Yandex to launch its sixth data center in Vladimir Oblast, adjacent to the existing Vladimir DC; projected capacity >40 MW, launch planned for early 2026; Zebra-TV reports construction in mikrorayon Energetik with 15-20 bn RUB investment. Construction under way per 2025-2026 local press; powered by FSK EES substation per VK reporting.

name: Oxygen data center (Tyumen) - first commercial TsOD in Tyumen Oblast
